modules.title: 一次预约从入口到成功或失败要经过哪些关键分支
User Flow 怎样把一项目标变成可检查的路径

items.title: 先固定用户、目标和起点
items.text: 说明是谁从哪个入口开始、想完成什么，以及什么结果才算结束；目标含糊时，路径很容易无限扩张。

items.title: 连接有意义的动作
items.text: 按顺序放入推动任务前进的页面、操作和决定，例如选择时段、提交资料和确认预约，不必记录每一次滚动或点击。

items.title: 补上关键分支与恢复
items.text: 标出无可用时段、资料错误或提交失败时用户会看到什么、能怎样返回主路径，避免只画理想成功路线。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: User Flow 不等于 sitemap、wireframe 或 customer journey：sitemap 表达页面与内容层级，wireframe 表达单个界面的元素和布局，customer journey 跨多个触点记录更完整的经历、感受与认知；User Flow 只聚焦一个目标在产品内的关键动作和决策分支。

lessonPractice.title: 团队要检查“访客完成预约”的路径。下面哪张图最符合 User Flow？

options.label: 从预约入口开始，经过选择时段和提交资料，分别画出有号、无号、提交成功、资料错误及返回修改的路径
options.feedback: 对。这张图围绕一个用户目标，包含起点、关键动作、决策分支、成功终点和失败后的恢复路径。

options.label: 按首页、服务、价格、帮助中心列出全站页面层级，不说明预约动作和结果
options.feedback: 这是 sitemap 的内容组织与导航结构，不能看出访客怎样完成一次预约。

options.label: 详细画出预约页每个输入框、按钮的尺寸与位置，但不连接操作顺序和异常分支
options.feedback: 这是 wireframe 更关心的界面布局。没有动作顺序和分支，就无法检查完整的用户路径。

en.title: A team wants to inspect the path for “a visitor completes a booking.” Which diagram is the best User Flow?

options.label: Start at the booking entry, continue through slot selection and details submission, and map available, unavailable, success, invalid-details, and return-to-edit paths
options.feedback: Correct. It centers on one user goal and includes an entry, key actions, decisions, a successful endpoint, and recovery from failure.

options.label: List the hierarchy of Home, Services, Pricing, and Help Center pages without showing booking actions or outcomes
options.feedback: That is sitemap content organization and navigation structure. It does not show how a visitor completes a booking.

options.label: Draw the exact size and position of every input and button on the booking screen without connecting the sequence or error branches
options.feedback: That is closer to a wireframe’s interface layout. Without actions and branches, the complete user path cannot be checked.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 帮我画“首次访客完成预约”的 User Flow。先用我提供的规则标出入口、关键动作、无可用时段和资料错误等分支，以及成功和恢复终点；缺少的业务规则列出来问我，不要补成全站 sitemap 或详细 wireframe。画完后顺着每条分支检查一次有没有断路。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Map the User Flow for “a first-time visitor completes a booking.” Use only the rules I provide to show the entry, key actions, branches such as no available slots and invalid details, plus success and recovery endpoints. Ask me about missing business rules instead of expanding this into a site-wide sitemap or detailed wireframe, then walk every branch to check for dead ends.

learning.assumes: You have used a multi-step task such as signing in, booking, or checking out.
learning.outcome: You can map the entry, key actions, required branches, and endpoints for one goal, and distinguish a user flow from a sitemap, wireframe, or customer journey.

modules.title: Map a booking from entry to success or recovery
How a user flow makes a goal testable

items.title: Fix the user, goal, and entry
items.text: Say who starts where, what they want to finish, and what counts as done.

items.title: Connect meaningful actions
items.text: Show the pages, actions, and decisions that move the task forward, not every scroll or click.

items.title: Add branches and recovery
items.text: Show what happens after an unavailable slot, bad details, or failed submission, and how the user returns to the main path.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A sitemap maps page hierarchy, a wireframe maps one screen, and a customer journey spans touchpoints and feelings. A user flow focuses on actions and decisions for one in-product goal.
